title: Wrong options true elsewhere in the text
statement: Use wrong options that are true elsewhere in the text, or were true earlier, but don't answer this question.
detail: A reading curriculum's lesson-components spec has its summary gap-fill use true-earlier-but-not-now distractors to test that the child tracked how things changed. A science lesson design uses a true fact from the text that is not the job of any plant part as its why-wrong option, and a built retell uses distractors true of the story but wrong at that gap, which its walkthrough says separates a retrieval task from a guessing game. Such options make the item test relevance and tracking rather than spotting a falsehood.
